name: 蕭榮修
objective:
1. 邏輯與證明
2. 集合, 關聯式與函數
3. 遞迴與演算法
4. 計數與機率（排列, 組合）
5. 遞迴式
6. 圖與樹（基礎圖論）

Objectives: This course covers the part of mathematics devoted to discrete events, i.e., events that involve distinct or unconnected elements, finite structures of distinct elements. These topics are very useful in the study of computer science --- especially in the areas of data structure, the analysis of algorithms, and the theory of computer languages.
課程進度(1-16週):
1. Introduction
2. Sets 
3. No Class (中秋假)
4. Relations and Functions
5. No Class (國慶日)
6. Logic
7. Proof
8. Mid-term Exam
9. Recursion, and Analysis of Algorithms
10. Recurrence Relations
11. Counting (Permutation) and Counting (Combination)
12. Probability
13. Graphs Theory
14. Trees and Trees Application
15. Final Exam
16. Term Project
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
